register.labelZh: DIAL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: dial in 和 dial into 可以描述在家中或另一座建築物內連接辦公室或學校的電腦。；如果電話系統要求你先按某個數字才能撥打外線,便可能會使用 dial out。；dial up 可以用來表示致電診所、酒店、餐廳、辦公室或撥打某個電話號碼。；這些表達可能出現在舊式電腦系統、辦公室電話和酒店電話的使用指示中。
register.summaryEn: Dial in and dial into can describe connecting to an office or school computer from home or another building. Dial out is useful when a telephone system requires you to press a number before making an outside call. Dial up can be used when calling a clinic, hotel, restaurant, office or telephone number. These expressions may appear in instructions for older computer systems, office telephones and hotel phones.
